parsed.internal_thinking: Alice has only 1 Wheat (Wh:1) in hand after the trade with Charlie. The dice roll of 5 resulted in Charlie getting Ore and Bob getting Sheep; Alice gained nothing because her settlements at Node 20 and 25 do not touch any '5' hexes (Hex 5 is a 6, Hex 17 is a 5 but Alice is at 25, not 41). Alice cannot build anything (needs Wood/Brick for roads and Wood/Brick/Sheep/Wheat for settlements). Her only viable moves are to trade or end the turn. Since Bob just gained a resource and Charlie is low, Alice will try to trade for Brick to eventually settle Node 9. However, with only 1 Wheat, her trading power is low. She will end her turn to see if better numbers roll.
parsed.note_to_self: I have 1 Wheat. Need Wood, Brick, and Sheep for my next settlement at Node 9. Charlie has Ore and Sheep; Bob has Sheep and Wheat. Robber is still on my Brick 6.
parsed.say_outloud: Well, it looks like that 5 was a bit of a dud for me, but at least Charlie's getting some use out of it. I'm going to hold onto what I've got for now and see what the next roll brings. Your move, Bob.
